# Hover shows the type-of answer of narrac query as a Markdown code block,
# with the effects on a `uses` line. Columns are UTF-16 units: `point` and
# LIMIT come after "é😀" on their line. Inside a template string with ${...}
# parts the whole template answers. A blank line gives null.
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"capabilities":{}}}
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"textDocument/didOpen","params":{"textDocument":{"uri":"file://$ROOT/src/main.nra","languageId":"narra","version":1,"text":"import * as Arrays from \"std/array\"\nimport * as Int from \"std/int\"\nimport * as Text from \"app/text\"\nimport { Point, Shape, UserId, helper, LIMIT } from \"app/text\"\n\nfunction area(shape: Shape): int {\n  if (shape is Shape.Circle(radius)) {\n    return radius * radius\n  }\n  return 0\n}\n\nexport function run(arguments: Array<string>): int uses io, alloc {\n  const point: Point = Point { x: Arrays.length(arguments), y: 2 }\n  const total = helper(\"é😀\") + point.x + LIMIT\n  print(`total ${Int.toString(total)}`)\n  const user: Text.UserId = UserId.from(1)\n  return area(Shape.Circle(2)) + total + UserId.toInt(user)\n}\n"}}}
# helper names a function: its type with the effects callers see
